topics.name: Compatibility Declaration
topics.purpose: Define explicit compatibility declarations between contract, format and release identities so additive evolution can be machine-read without assuming compatibility from similar version numbers.

semantics.additive_rule: Additive evolution may remain compatible when existing required semantics are preserved.
semantics.breaking_rule: Breaking semantic change requires a new identity where the owning versioning contract requires it.
semantics.declaration_rule: Compatibility is explicit evidence/metadata, not inferred solely from semantic-version-like numbers.
semantics.consumer_rule: Consumer declares supported compatibility surface and hard-fails unsupported required semantics.
semantics.projection_rule: Projection-only additions do not imply runtime compatibility changes unless machine semantics change.

invariants.rule: Release, replacement, rollback, deprecation and compatibility decisions remain explicit, snapshot-bound and traceable; no lifecycle label silently changes canonical semantics.

hard_gates.condition: compatibility inferred solely from version number
breaking semantics published under identity requiring additive-only evolution
